title: sNucDrop-seq Protocol
author: Peng Hu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vfse3ne
materials: Preheat thermocycler to 55°C. For each sample, take out 550 pg of purified cDNA with H 2 O in a total volume of 5 μL to a PCR tube.

Prepare homogenization buffer (50 mL): ReagentsVol.H2O40.89 mL2 M Sucrose8 mL0.5 M CaCl2500 μL1 M Tris-HCl pH 8.0500 μL 3 M MgAc250 μL100% Triton50 μL0.5 M EDTA10 μL1 tablet protease inhibitor w/o EDTA
Prepare lysis buffer (makes 1 mL): ReagentsVol. (μL)H2O40020% Ficoll PM-40030020% Sarkosyl100.5 M EDTA401.0 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.52001.0 M DTT50
Draw up 7 mL of droplet generation oil (Bio-Rad) into a 10-mL Luer-lock syringe. 7 mL, Droplet generation oil
Add to each PCR tube in the following order: ReagentsVol. (μL)Nextra PCR mix152 μM P5-TSO hybrid primer52 μM Nextera N70X oligo5

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and barcoded beads for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Cool the ultracentrifuge to 4 °C before preparing buffers.
Prepare 50 mL of sucrose cushion.
Wash ChemGenes barcoded beads once with 30 mL of 100% ethanol and twice with 30 mL of TE-TW (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA and 0.01% Tween-20).
Remove the oil layer from the bottom of the 50-mL tube.
Wash beads once with 1 mL H2O and spin at 1000X g for 1 min.
Prepare 200 μL of RT mix and 200 μL of Exonuclease mix.

steps.title: Isolate Nuclei
steps.instruction: Extract nuclei from adult mouse cortical tissues using a sucrose cushion and dounce homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Add 14 mL of sucrose cushion to the bottom of a 1 x 3.5 in (25 x 98 mm) Beckman centrifuge tube and keep on ice.
Add 12 mL of homogenization buffer into a dounce tissue grinder; dounce 21 times with a loose pestle, then 7 more times with a tight pestle.
Carefully transfer the homogenate atop the sucrose cushion and add an additional 12 mL of homogenization buffer atop the homogenate.
Centrifuge at 25,000 rpm for 2 hours at 4 °C to pellet nuclei.
Remove the tube from the rotor and keep on ice.
Remove the supernatant and add 1 mL chilled resuspension buffer (0.01% BSA in DPBS with RNase inhibitor). Incubate on ice for 20 min.
Resuspend the nuclei pellet and transfer to a 1.5-mL lobind tube; wash the centrifuge tube with 0.5 mL chilled resuspension buffer and add to the lobind tube.
Spin down nuclei at 5,000 rpm for 15 minutes at 4 °C, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 1.5 mL resuspension buffer to remove excess sucrose cushion.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei and Bead Suspensions
steps.instruction: Filter and dilute nuclei and beads to the required concentrations for microfluidics.

substeps.instruction: Filter nuclei twice with a 40-µm cell strainer, count them, and dilute to 100 nuclei/μL with resuspension buffer.
Transfer 2 mL of nuclei suspension into a 3-mL Luer-lock syringe.
Pass beads through a 100-µm cell strainer and count them.
Re-suspend beads at 120 beads/μL concentration in 1.5 mL lysis buffer and transfer into a 3-mL Luer lock syringe.

steps.title: Generate Droplets
steps.instruction: Use a microfluidic device to encapsulate nuclei and beads into droplets.

substeps.instruction: Connect syringes containing nuclei, beads, and oil to an Aquapel-coated PDMS Microfluidic device (µFluidix) with flow rates: Oil (15,000 μL/hr), Nuclei (4,000 μL/hr), and Beads (4,000 μL/hr).
Start pumps in the order: nuclei → beads → oil.
Collect ~20 μL of aqueous flow to verify droplet quality (uniform size, doublet rate < 5%).
Collect 1.0 mL of droplets into a 50-mL conical tube.

steps.title: Break Droplets and Recover Beads
steps.instruction: Break the oil emulsion to recover the barcoded beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 mL of room temperature 6X SSC to the tube.
In a fume hood, add 1 mL of Perfluorooctanol (PFO), shake rigorously 4 times, and spin at 1000Xg for 1 min.
Remove the top supernatant, add 20 mL of 6X SSC, wait for oil to sink, and transfer the supernatant to a new 50-mL tube.
Add another 20 mL of 6X SSC to recover remaining beads and combine the supernatants.
Spin at 1000xg for 2 min to pellet the beads.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription (RT)
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription on the captured nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Remove all but ~1 mL of liquid from the pellet and transfer beads to a 1.5-mL lobind tube.
Spin at 1000X g for 1 min, remove supernatant, wash beads twice with 1 mL of 6X SSC, and once with ~300 μL 2X RT buffer.
Remove as much 2X RT buffer as possible and add 200 μL of RT mix.
Incubate beads at room temperature for 30 min with rotation, then 150 min at 42 °C with rotation.

steps.title: Exonuclease Treatment and Bead Counting
steps.instruction: Remove unused primers and quantify the bead concentration.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads once with 1 mL TE-SDS (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA and 0.5% SDS) and twice with 1 mL TE-TW.
Wash beads once with 1 mL 10mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 and resuspend in 200 μL of exonuclease mix.
Incubate beads at 37°C for 45 min with rotation.
Wash beads once with 1 mL TE-SDS and twice with 1 mL TE-TW.
Remove supernatant and resuspend beads in 1 mL H2O.
Count beads by transferring 1 μL of beads into 50 μL H2O in a 96-well plate (repeat 3x and average); expected concentration is 40-70 beads/μL.

steps.title: TSO-PCR Optimization
steps.instruction: Determine the optimal number of PCR cycles to avoid over-amplification.

substeps.instruction: Transfer an aliquot of 6,000 beads into a PCR tube, spin down, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 50 μL PCR mix (25 μL KAPA HiFi HS Readymix, 0.4 μL 100 μM TSO-PCR primer, 24.6 μL H2O).
Run 1st round TSO-PCR: 95 °C for 3 min; 4 cycles of (98 °C 20s, 65 °C 45s, 72 °C 3 min); 9 cycles of (98 °C 20s, 67 °C 20s, 72 °C 3 min); then 72 °C for 5 min and 4 °C hold.
Purify PCR products twice with 0.6X (30 μL) SPRI beads and elute in 10 μL H2O.
Measure concentration by Qubit (expected 100-600 pg/μL for mouse cortical nuclei).
Perform real-time PCR analysis using 1 μL purified cDNA, 0.2 μL 25 μM TSO-PCR primer, 5 μL 2X KAPA FAST qPCR Readymix, and 3.8 μL H2O.
Run real-time PCR: 95 °C for 3 min, then 25 cycles of (95 °C 15s, 63 °C 30s, 72 °C 30s).
Quantify cDNA library by Qubit (expected 800-2000 pg/μL) and check fragment size via Bioanalyzer (expected 1300-2000 bp).

steps.title: Large-scale TSO-PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA library using the optimized cycle number.

substeps.instruction: Wash remaining beads twice with 1 mL H2O.
Apportion 6,000 beads per reaction, spin down, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 50 μL PCR mix.
Run PCR: 95 °C for 3 min; 4 cycles of (98 °C 20s, 65 °C 45s, 72 °C 3 min); 9 plus additional optimized cycles of (98 °C 20s, 67 °C 20s, 72 °C 3 min); then 72 °C for 5 min and 4 °C hold.
Combine PCR products for a sample into a 1.5-mL lobind tube and purify twice with 0.6X SPRI beads; elute in H2O (1/5 volume of PCR product).

steps.title: Library Tagmentation and Final PCR
steps.instruction: Tagment the cDNA and perform final amplification for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 μL Nextera TD buffer and 5 μL Amplicon Tagmentation enzyme to each reaction; mix by pipetting ~5 times.
Incubate at 55 °C for 5 min.
Add 5 μL Neutralization Buffer, mix by pipetting ~5 times, spin down, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Run PCR: 95 °C for 30 s; 12 cycles of (95 °C 10s, 55 °C 30s, 72 °C 30s); then 72 °C for 5 min and 4 °C hold.
Purify PCR product twice with 0.6X SPRI beads and elute in 10 μL H2O.
Quantify by Qubit and check fragment size by Bioanalyzer (expected 500-700 bp).

steps.title: Sequencing Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the library for Illumina NextSeq 500 sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Denature the library and dilute to 2.0 pM; load to position 10.
Dilute custom Read1 primer (0.3 μM) and load to position 7.
Use sequencing specifications: 20 bp (Read1; custom read1 primer), 8 bp (Index1), and 50-60 bp (Read2).
